intent: An agent presents a choice mid-run and waits: options with a recommended one, or a free-text answer. Confirm or skip, then one line.
useWhen: an agent needs the person to pick between options before it continues
a short free-text answer the agent waits for
the agent can fall back to a default when skipped
doNotUseWhen: one side effect to approve — ApprovalCard
a form the person fills on their own — Field / RadioGroup

options.note: { id, label, description?, recommended?, disabled?, disabledReason? }[] as a kit RadioGroup (card layout). recommended shows a quiet Badge. A disabled option stays in the group and shows disabledReason in place of its description.

allowFreeText.note: Free text when there are no options.

freeTextHint.default: One or two sentences is enough.

value.note: Option id or free-text answer. Confirm is disabled until set.

status.note: resolved and skipped render one line.

resolvedLabel.note: Line text; default the chosen option's label.

onConfirm.note: Confirm (⌘⏎ key chip, no icon), the one solid primary while it waits; outline while sending or after an error. ⌘/Ctrl+Enter inside the card.

onSkip.note: Skip for now (ghost). Escape while focus is in the card but not on another control.

requirements: options are a kit RadioGroup named by the question
a disabled option stays in the RadioGroup, disabled, with its reason as the description, so it is announced, not skipped
free text is a Field-wrapped Textarea with a hint
Confirm and Skip carry aria-keyshortcuts; ⌘/Ctrl+Enter confirms and Escape skips (not on another control) inside the card; Confirm shows ⌘⏎ as an aria-hidden key chip, hidden on touch screens
sending sets aria-busy and announces in a status region
once resolved, focus moves to the one-line row
motion is opacity and transform only, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local DecisionCard, ChoiceCard, or AgentQuestion
Do not start with nothing selected when an option is recommended; list it first and start value on it
Confirm is the one solid primary; Skip is ghost
snippet: <DecisionCard title="Dunning agent asks" meta="paused · 09:12" question="Which Northwind invoices should I chase this week?" options={[{ id: "pair", label: "INV-1842 and INV-1857", description: "$3,860.00, both over 14 days late", recommended: true }, { id: "all", label: "All four open invoices" }, { id: "1799", label: "INV-1799", disabled: true, disabledReason: "Unavailable: in collections since 2 Nov" }]} value={value} onValueChange={setValue} onConfirm={send} onSkip={skip} />
